fm1Emu.wasmProvenance: Built here from upstream source at sourceRevision with fm1-emu-usb.patch (three exports for a USB cable to the page: fm1_usb_plug, fm1_usb_send, fm1_usb_take; fm1_soc::usb is upstream's), by web/build.sh with Rust 1.99.1, wasm32-unknown-unknown.
fm1Emu.localChanges: worklet.js and jit.js: upstream's at sourceRevision. worklet.js: boot takes flashPatch (bytes written into the flash before it runs: an LSDj save) and usb (plugs the cable); messages "usb" (one MIDI message to the FM-1) and "usb-out" (what it sent). The panel picture is drawn by emulator/face.js; fm1-emu's panel only says where its controls are.
